comment: shk.c splitbill() 3628-3632 and onbill() 1150-1153. Sell three wished darts in a general store and pick them up (unpaid). #wiztelekinesis hurtles the keeper out through the door: mhurtle() angers him but never calls setpaid(), so the bill survives while he is out of his shop. Throwing one dart splits the stack: splitbill() finds no resident shopkeeper. The dart lands where costly_spot() is false (the keeper is away), so check_shop_obj() calls stolen_value(), whose billable() finds no tending keeper, and its onbill(obj, NULL, FALSE) reports the unpaid dart without a shopkeeper.
